verdicts.reason: A breaks the design: the headline 'Order online' has shrunk to a tiny block off-axis from the rules, while 'food & drinks' is blown up larger than the headline and runs onto the kraft box. That inverts the hierarchy and leaves the rules floating apart from the text. B keeps the original's centred lockup (rules, headline, subline) intact and in proportion on a nearly identical canvas; it only needs minor polish, since the left side has a little more empty space and the bottom box sits close to the edge.
